new.brief: Creates a new event controller that will handle focus events.
new.md: Creates a new event controller that will handle focus events.

doc.md:
Tracks keyboard focus.

The event controller offers [`EventControllerFocus::enter`](xref:gtk:Gtk.EventControllerFocus#event:enter)
and [`EventControllerFocus::leave`](xref:gtk:Gtk.EventControllerFocus#event:leave) signals, as well as
[`EventControllerFocus:is-focus`](xref:gtk:Gtk.EventControllerFocus#property:is-focus) and
[`EventControllerFocus:contains-focus`](xref:gtk:Gtk.EventControllerFocus#property:contains-focus) properties
which are updated to reflect focus changes inside the widget hierarchy
that is rooted at the controllers widget.

contains_focus.brief: Returns `TRUE` if focus is within `self` or one of its children.
contains_focus.md: Returns `TRUE` if focus is within `self` or one of its children.

is_focus.brief: Returns `TRUE` if focus is within `self`, but not one of its children.
is_focus.md: Returns `TRUE` if focus is within `self`, but not one of its children.

contains-focus.brief: `TRUE` if focus is contained in the controllers widget.
contains-focus.md:
`TRUE` if focus is contained in the controllers widget.

See [`EventControllerFocus:is-focus`](xref:gtk:Gtk.EventControllerFocus#property:is-focus) for whether
the focus is in the widget itself or inside a descendent.

When handling focus events, this property is updated
before [`EventControllerFocus::enter`](xref:gtk:Gtk.EventControllerFocus#event:enter) or
[`EventControllerFocus::leave`](xref:gtk:Gtk.EventControllerFocus#event:leave) are emitted.

is-focus.brief: `TRUE` if focus is in the controllers widget itself, as opposed to in a descendent widget.
is-focus.md:
`TRUE` if focus is in the controllers widget itself,
as opposed to in a descendent widget.

See also [`EventControllerFocus:contains-focus`](xref:gtk:Gtk.EventControllerFocus#property:contains-focus).

When handling focus events, this property is updated
before [`EventControllerFocus::enter`](xref:gtk:Gtk.EventControllerFocus#event:enter) or
[`EventControllerFocus::leave`](xref:gtk:Gtk.EventControllerFocus#event:leave) are emitted.

enter.brief: Emitted whenever the focus enters into the widget or one of its descendents.
enter.md:
Emitted whenever the focus enters into the widget or one
of its descendents.

Note that this means you may not get an ::enter signal
even though the widget becomes the focus location, in
certain cases (such as when the focus moves from a descendent
of the widget to the widget itself). If you are interested
in these cases, you can monitor the
[`EventControllerFocus:is-focus`](xref:gtk:Gtk.EventControllerFocus#property:is-focus)
property for changes.

leave.brief: Emitted whenever the focus leaves the widget hierarchy that is rooted at the widget that the controller is attached to.
leave.md:
Emitted whenever the focus leaves the widget hierarchy
that is rooted at the widget that the controller is attached to.

Note that this means you may not get a ::leave signal
even though the focus moves away from the widget, in
certain cases (such as when the focus moves from the widget
to a descendent). If you are interested in these cases, you
can monitor the [`EventControllerFocus:is-focus`](xref:gtk:Gtk.EventControllerFocus#property:is-focus)
property for changes.
